## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, current behavior and what this change does. Link relevant issues and the paired core PR when needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`, hosted build and relevant `npm test` cases pass.
- [ ] Wrapper/package tests pass if those paths change.
- [ ] Relevant Default/Light/Dark, en/de/fr, currency, alpha/striped colors and mobile/keyboard/scroll cases checked.
- [ ] Relevant account switching, permissions, pagination and data-preservation cases checked.
- [ ] Screenshots show the tested UI/data; no credentials or database files are attached.
- [ ] Upstream provenance/credit preserved. No release or production deployment is implied.

List commands/results and anything not checked. Mark inapplicable items rather than claiming them as tested.
